## GTA 6 Weapons & Arsenal Database (40+ Confirmed Weapons)
GTA 6 implements a limited on-person inventory with weapon trunk armory mechanics.
Car trunks store heavy weapons, shotguns, and long rifles.

### Handguns & Revolvers

## GTA 6 Characters & Cast
Dual protagonists operate across the state of Leonida.
- Jason Duval: Former military veteran operating around Key Lento and Keys smuggling boatyards.
- Lucia Caminos: First female playable protagonist in 3D GTA history; released on parole from Leonida Penitentiary.
- Cal Hampton: Jason's associate, Coast Guard communications listener (Bobby Moynihan).
- Boobie Ike: "Jack of Hearts" nightlife and recording studio kingpin in Vice City (Mike Forbs).
- Dre'Quan Priest: Founder of Only Raw Records (Naiqui Macabroad).
- Brian Heder: Golden age Keys drug runner and boatyard operator (Stephen Root).
- Raul Bautista: Seasoned bank robber and heist coordinator.
- Real Dimez (Bae-Luxe & Roxy): Social media rappers signed to Only Raw Records.
- Strangers & Freaks: Andy, Billy, Kenton, Kirk (Skunk Ape hunter), Pilot Pete, Randy.

## GTA 6 Map & World (State of Leonida)
Leonida is estimated at 2.5x to 3x the scale of GTA V with 5 counties and over 65% enterable interiors.
1. Vice-Dale County: Downtown Vice City, Vice Beach, Ocean Drive, Starfish Island, VCIA International Airport.
2. Kelly County: Industrial shipping center of Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia sugar mills, Route 628.
3. Mariana County & The Keys: Tropical barrier islands (Key Lento, Big Pine) connected by the Overseas Highway.
4. Leonard County: Freshwater reservoir around Lake Leonida and quiet lakeside townships.
5. Lummox County: Northern wilderness, Mount Kalaga national park, and Dawson Dam.

## Key Facts
- Launched 19 November 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. No PC version at launch.
- Physical copies are code-in-box download vouchers in retail editions.
- Standard Edition $79.99 USD; Ultimate Edition $99.99+ USD.
- Setting: State of Leonida, Vice City.
- Franchise Metacritic scores: GTA III (97), Vice City (95), San Andreas (95), GTA IV (98), GTA V (97), GTA VI (99).
